list.title: Leads near me
list.intro: Dental clinics Google Maps lists around your base, nearest first. Visit one, record the clinic's details, and it becomes a prospect.
list.notConfigured: Clinic names are not available yet. Ask the owner to finish the Google Maps setup.
list.notConfiguredSetupHint: Setup detail (owner and admins only): the Google Maps server key GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY is not set, so the daily clinic search does not run and clinic names cannot be loaded.
list.budgetReached: This month's Google budget is used up: some clinic names are not shown. The owner can raise the budget.
list.noBase: Your base location is not set yet, so no leads have been searched for you. Ask the office to set it.
list.empty: No open leads. New clinics appear after the next discovery run.
list.notSeenLately: Not found in the last search
list.detailsError: Clinic names could not be loaded from Google right now. Try again later.

notes.label: My notes
notes.hint: Your own notes (best time to visit, who to ask for). Do not paste text from Google.

convert.title: First visit
convert.intro: At the clinic, record what the clinic tells you. This becomes HONEST's own customer record at stage prospect.
convert.phoneHint: Egyptian number. You can add it on a later visit.
convert.pinHint: Next you check in at the clinic: your phone's location is proposed as the clinic pin, and a manager confirms it.

map.label: Map of the leads on this page

done.queued: Saved. A new search around the base is queued.

errors.DAILY_CAP: That day already has the most visits allowed in a plan.
errors.PAST_DATE: A visit cannot be planned in the past.
errors.NO_BASE_LOCATION: Set the rep's base location first (Admin → Setup).
errors.ALREADY_CUSTOMER: This clinic is already a customer.
errors.DUPLICATE_CUSTOMER: This phone number already belongs to a customer.
errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: The Google Maps setup is not finished, so the search did not run.
errors.CAP_REACHED: Today's Google request limit is reached. The search waits for tomorrow, or raise the limit.
errors.BUDGET_REACHED: This month's Google budget is reached. The search waits, or raise the budget.

routeError.title: Leads could not be loaded
routeError.body: Something went wrong while loading this page. Try again.

team.title: Leads by rep
team.intro: Leads found around each rep's base, how many were visited and how many became CRM records.

budget.title: Google cost guard
budget.month: Estimated spend this month: {spent} of {budget} USD ({details} clinic names loaded).
budget.note: Estimates use Google's list price and ignore its free monthly usage, so the real bill is lower. Set a budget alert in Google Cloud as well.

stats.title: Per rep
stats.definitions: Visited = visited, prospect or customer. Converted = became a CRM record (prospect or customer). Became customers = the clinic's customer record became active (usually with its first order).

reps.title: Search around each rep
reps.empty: No rep has a base location yet.
